cond: A SMALL CORRECTION WITH A REAL CONSEQUENCE, AND I AM RECORDING IT BEFORE IT CATCHES US RATHER THAN AFTER. || THIS BOARD HAS CARRIED THE NOTE "BANGKOK = NEW YORK + 11 HOURS, US SESSION 20:30-03:00 BANGKOK" FOR WEEKS. IT IS CORRECT TODAY, BECAUSE NEW YORK IS ON EASTERN **DAYLIGHT** TIME. IT STOPS BEING CORRECT ON **SUNDAY 1 NOVEMBER 2026**, WHEN AMERICAN CLOCKS GO BACK AN HOUR AND NEW YORK RETURNS TO EASTERN **STANDARD** TIME. THAILAND DOES NOT OBSERVE DAYLIGHT SAVING AT ALL, SO THE WHOLE DIFFERENCE MOVES TO TWELVE HOURS. || WHAT CHANGES FOR SALEE, EXACTLY: THE US MARKET OPENS AT 9:30 IN THE MORNING NEW YORK TIME ALL YEAR. TODAY THAT IS **20:30 BANGKOK**. FROM 1 NOVEMBER IT IS **21:30 BANGKOK**. THE CLOSE MOVES FROM 03:00 TO **04:00 BANGKOK**. MY STANDING ADVICE TO PLACE ORDERS BETWEEN 20:30 AND ABOUT 22:00 THEREFORE BECOMES **21:30 TO ABOUT 23:00** FROM 1 NOVEMBER. || ⚠️ WHY IT MATTERS MORE THAN IT SOUNDS: A DAY ORDER PLACED AT 20:45 BANGKOK ON 2 NOVEMBER WOULD BE PLACED **FORTY-FIVE MINUTES BEFORE THE MARKET OPENS**, NOT FIFTEEN MINUTES AFTER. Depending on the broker it either queues, is rejected, or sits in a pre-market session with far worse prices. THE BOARD HAS ALREADY LOST MONEY ONCE THIS MONTH TO A MISREAD PRICE; LOSING IT TO A MISREAD CLOCK WOULD BE WORSE, BECAUSE IT IS ENTIRELY AVOIDABLE. || THE UK AND EUROPE CHANGE ON A DIFFERENT DATE FROM THE UNITED STATES, SO BETWEEN LATE OCTOBER AND EARLY NOVEMBER THE GAPS ARE BRIEFLY UNUSUAL. THIS BOARD ONLY TRADES US EQUITIES, SO ONLY THE 1 NOVEMBER DATE MATTERS TO US. NOTHING ELSE ON THE BOARD CHANGES.
dl: ⚠️⚠️ CLOCK CHANGE 1 NOVEMBER - Salee's trading window moves one hour LATER. Correct my own standing note.
w: ON SUNDAY 1 NOVEMBER 2026 US DAYLIGHT SAVING ENDS. BANGKOK GOES FROM **NEW YORK PLUS 11** TO **NEW YORK PLUS 12**. THE US REGULAR SESSION MOVES FROM 20:30-03:00 BANGKOK TO **21:30-04:00 BANGKOK**. ⚠️ MY STANDING NOTE SAYS 'BANGKOK = NEW YORK + 11' WITH NO QUALIFIER. THAT IS ONLY TRUE IN THE AMERICAN SUMMER.

SCORED: (1) premium 23.9% - moderate, but MRVL has fallen ~22% since 28 Oct, so at the 30 Oct close the offer is worth ~$884/LITE, BELOW LITE's unaffected price; (2) no cash/no new debt - MRVL holders diluted to 67%; (3) accretion claimed on NON-GAAP only - check GAAP in the S-4; (4) ~18 months to close, China approval the main risk. OUR POSITION: MRVL 95.5 sh + LITE 11.5 sh (-> 51.75 MRVL sh at close) = 147.25 MRVL sh, ~$28.9k at 30 Oct closes, ~3.6% of the book. ACTION: HOLD BOTH, no buy, no sale.
